_comment: Transitional worklist for InfluxDB v1 shared-content migration. Each entry is a page that still exists as two copies (OSS v1 and Enterprise v1) and is intended to become shared content. CI fails if a pull request increases the divergence between a pair. Remove an entry when its page moves to content/shared/influxdb-v1/. When this list is empty, delete this file and its workflow.
